Converts handwritten notes between Samsung Notes (.sdocx), Boox Notes (.note) and Saber (.sba). Everything runs on this device; no data is collected or sent anywhere.

None of these formats is publicly documented; the converters are based on community reverse-engineering and are experimental. A conversion may lose or alter content (typed text, images, PDF backgrounds and templates are not converted), and an app update may make converted files unreadable. Always keep your original files and check the result before deleting anything. The app is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, and the authors are not liable for any lost or damaged notes.
